breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: particle diameter given in mm is substituted as meters, producing an orders-of-magnitude error in the Ergun pressure drop.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the unit inconsistency. The ground truth corrects the prompt by instructing to convert the particle diameter from 5 mm to its SI unit equivalent, 0.005 m. The generated specification, however, explicitly repeated the original error by stating to 'Use particle diameter entered incorrectly as d_p = 5 m (i.e., treat the given “5 mm” as if it were “5 m”).'
